```artifact
Feature: System Back-up and User Management

  Scenario: Full back-up of the system every night
    Given the system is running
    When the system reaches the end of the day
    Then a full back-up of the system (both Database and Code) shall be taken
    And the back-up shall be sent to the remote site for safekeeping
    And the back-up shall be rotated every 30 days

  Scenario: Backup failure scenario
    Given the system is running
    When the system reaches the end of the day
    And the backup process fails
    Then an error message shall be logged
    And the backup shall not be sent to the remote site

  Scenario: Backup rotation on 29 days
    Given the system is running
    When the system reaches the end of the 29th day
    Then a full back-up of the system (both Database and Code) shall be taken
    And the back-up shall be sent to the remote site for safekeeping
    And the back-up shall be rotated every 30 days

  Scenario: Backup rotation on 31 days
    Given the system is running
    When the system reaches the end of the 31st day
    Then a full back-up of the system (both Database and Code) shall be taken
    And the back-up shall be sent to the remote site for safekeeping
    And the back-up shall be rotated every 30 days

  Scenario: Doctor changes password
    Given the system is running
    And a doctor is logged in
    When the doctor changes their password
    And the new password is confirmed
    Then the doctor's password shall be updated
    And the doctor shall be able to log in with the new password

  Scenario: Doctor changes password with mismatched confirmation
    Given the system is running
    And a doctor is logged in
    When the doctor changes their password
    And the new password is not confirmed
    Then an error message shall be displayed
    And the doctor's password shall not be updated

  Scenario: Chemist changes password
    Given the system is running
    And a chemist is logged in
    When the chemist changes their password
    And the new password is confirmed
    Then the chemist's password shall be updated
    And the chemist shall be able to log in with the new password

  Scenario: Chemist changes password with mismatched confirmation
    Given the system is running
    And a chemist is logged in
    When the chemist changes their password
    And the new password is not confirmed
    Then an error message shall be displayed
    And the chemist's password shall not be updated

  Scenario: Lab changes password
    Given the system is running
    And a lab is logged in
    When the lab changes their password
    And the new password is confirmed
    Then the lab's password shall be updated
    And the lab shall be able to log in with the new password

  Scenario: Lab changes password with mismatched confirmation
    Given the system is running
    And a lab is logged in
    When the lab changes their password
    And the new password is not confirmed
    Then an error message shall be displayed
    And the lab's password shall not be updated

  Scenario: Patient registers with valid credentials
    Given the system is running
    When a patient registers with a valid User-id and Password
    Then the patient's User-id and Password shall be stored
    And the patient shall be able to log in with the User-id and Password

  Scenario: Patient registers with invalid credentials
    Given the system is running
    When a patient registers with an invalid User-id or Password
    Then an error message shall be displayed
    And the patient's User-id and Password shall not be stored

  Scenario: Doctor wise Appointment file for next 5 days
    Given the system is running
    When the system reaches the end of the month
    Then the Doctor wise Appointment file for next 5 days shall be generated
    And the file shall be stored at the remote site

  Scenario: Speciality wise - Number of Consultations by Doctor per month
    Given the system is running
    When the system reaches the end of the month
    Then the Speciality wise - Number of Consultations by Doctor per month shall be generated
    And the file shall be stored at the remote site

  Scenario: Speciality wise - Revenue Earned per month
    Given the system is running
    When the system reaches the end of the month
    Then the Speciality wise - Revenue Earned per month shall be generated
    And the file shall be stored at the remote site

  Scenario: Speciality wise - Number of Consultations by Doctor per quarter
    Given the system is running
    When the system reaches the end of the quarter
    Then the Speciality wise - Number of Consultations by Doctor per quarter shall be generated
    And the file shall be stored at the remote site

  Scenario: Speciality wise - Revenue Earned per quarter
    Given the system is running
    When the system reaches the end of the quarter
    Then the Speciality wise - Revenue Earned per quarter shall be generated
    And the file shall be stored at the remote site

  Scenario: Speciality wise - Number of Consultations by Doctor per year
    Given the system is running
    When the system reaches the end of the year
    Then the Speciality wise - Number of Consultations by Doctor per year shall be generated
    And the file shall be stored at the remote site

  Scenario: Speciality wise - Revenue Earned per year
    Given the system is running
    When the system reaches the end of the year
    Then the Speciality wise - Revenue Earned per year shall be generated
    And the file shall be stored at the remote site
```
